title: The Satoshi Embodiment: A 32-Byte Hash Riding Real Satoshis Across a Bitcoin Mainnet Custody Walk
description:
The core embodiment of hash-only tokenization, executed live on Bitcoin mainnet: a 32-byte SHA-256 digest rode real satoshis across a full custody walk, out and back. The asset digest (66dc843a...ee9de2b, paper "Deterministically Governed Probabilistic Neural Mesh" v1.1, patent application 64/119,191) was carried by 1,000 sats from wallet A to wallet B with the payload in OP_RETURN (tx c800820c..., block 972097), then returned to A on the same rails carrying the identical payload (tx ef1fce19...). Keyless pull-back verified both directions byte-exact. Total postage: 883 sats (about nine cents). No token issued; no coin created. This record is itself then tokenized on both rails (Bitcoin OP_RETURN + XRPL custody round trip), closing the loop: the paper about the embodiment carries the embodiment's receipts and rides them itself.

Three proofs, one digest, one day: permanence (Bitcoin block 972047 hash-only anchor), velocity (XRP ledgers 107746115-107746135 custody walk), and embodiment (block 972097, the hash riding a satoshi). Public verification portal: https://deterministic-code-dsos.base44.app/genesis-viewer (keyless, in-browser).

Dual Mesh Benchmark status: MEASURED (scoped) - no neural-mesh inference in any ceremony decision path; program benchmark DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23321637. Related records: 10.5281/zenodo.23448049 (Hash Is the Artifact), 10.5281/zenodo.23455768 (DROPBOX-M1-001), 10.5281/zenodo.23456550 (End-to-End Tokenization), 10.5281/zenodo.23462705 (Four-Tokenization Proof Day). Communities: DCAI and SQUIRL OS. Two-key curation: drafted and vetted by the system (Gabriel), published on the owner's explicit GO (chat authorization, 2026-10-18); operator chat text is not reproduced. This software is a prototype and is provided for educational and research purposes only. It is not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments. No client-identifiable data, no PHI (POL-DISC-001).
